115: func (s *Service) stop() error {
116: 	return errors.Join(s.closeApp(), s.releaseAccountLease())
117: }

119: // closeApp closes all account components but deliberately retains the account
120: // lease. Operations such as restart, move, and deletion must remain protected
121: // until they have finished touching account data.
122: func (s *Service) closeApp() error {
123: 	ctx, task := trace.NewTask(context.Background(), "application.stop")
124: 	defer task.End()
125: 
126: 	if s != nil && s.app != nil {
127: 		mwVersion := vcs.GetVCSInfo().Version()
128: 		log.Infow("closing app: initiated", "mwVersion", mwVersion)
129: 		s.app.SetDeviceState(int(domain.CompStateAppClosingInitiated))
130: 		start := time.Now()
131: 		closeErr := s.app.Close(ctx)
132: 		if closeErr != nil {
133: 			log.Warnf("error while stop anytype: %v", closeErr)
134: 		}
135: 		log.Infow("closing app: finished", "mwVersion", mwVersion, "tookMs", time.Since(start).Milliseconds())
136: 		// Drain zap's buffered sink (the "closing app: finished" line above
137: 		// must reach disk) and stop the lumberjack flush goroutine. Both
138: 		// calls are bounded so a stuck disk doesn't hang process exit;
139: 		// errors are benign (stderr Sync can fail on some platforms) and
140: 		// intentionally ignored.
141: 		_ = logging.SyncWithTimeout(3 * time.Second)
142: 		_ = logging.CloseSink(3 * time.Second)
143: 
144: 		s.app = nil
145: 		return closeErr
146: 	}
147: 	return nil
148: }
